items.title: Stretch boxes
items.sub: On a wide screen the columns fill the width, so the boxes are wider

items.title: Scale content
items.sub: The content of a stretched box grows with it, so the box is taller too (off: the content keeps its size)

items.title: Fit to screen
items.sub: The main screen is made as big as it can be without scrolling, so there is no empty space under it (the columns fill the width; neither Stretch nor scaling is needed)

items.title: Rearrange the main screen
items.sub: A handle on each tile lets you drag it to another place; the modules take that order (the same as dragging them in Modules)

items.title: Ask for the PIN to open Settings
items.sub: The dashboard keeps working without it; opening Settings and changing anything in it needs the PIN. Set a PIN below first.

control.label: Ask for the PIN to open Settings

items.title: PIN
items.sub: 4 to 64 characters. It is also asked for before and any other action that can change the machine.

items.title: Global main colour
items.sub: Pick Global main for a box or a row of lights to give them this colour
